Creates a new `GtkDropDown`.

You may want to call [`DropDown.set_factory()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#method:set_factory)
to set up a way to map its items to widgets.

doc.brief: Allows the user to choose an item from a list of options.
doc.md:
Allows the user to choose an item from a list of options.

The `GtkDropDown` displays the [selected][`DropDown:selected`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#property:selected)
choice.

The options are given to `GtkDropDown` in the form of `GListModel`
and how the individual options are represented is determined by
a [`ListItemFactory`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItemFactory). The default factory displays simple strings,
and adds a checkmark to the selected item in the popup.

To set your own factory, use [`DropDown.set_factory()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#method:set_factory). It is
possible to use a separate factory for the items in the popup, with
[`DropDown.set_list_factory()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#method:set_list_factory).

`GtkDropDown` knows how to obtain strings from the items in a
[`StringList`](xref:gtk:Gtk.StringList); for other models, you have to provide an expression
to find the strings via [`DropDown.set_expression()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#method:set_expression).

`GtkDropDown` can optionally allow search in the popup, which is
useful if the list of options is long. To enable the search entry,
use [`DropDown.set_enable_search()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#method:set_enable_search).

Here is a UI definition example for `GtkDropDown` with a simple model:

```xml
<object class="GtkDropDown">
  <property name="model">
    <object class="GtkStringList">
      <items>
        <item translatable="yes">Factory</item>
        <item translatable="yes">Home</item>
        <item translatable="yes">Subway</item>
      </items>
    </object>
  </property>
</object>
```

If a `GtkDropDown` is created in this manner, or with
[`DropDown.new_from_strings()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#constructor:new_from_strings), for instance, the object returned from
[`DropDown.get_selected_item()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#method:get_selected_item) will be a [`StringObject`](xref:gtk:Gtk.StringObject).

To learn more about the list widget framework, see the
[overview](section-list-widget.html).

## CSS nodes

`GtkDropDown` has a single CSS node with name dropdown,
with the button and popover nodes as children.

## Accessibility

`GtkDropDown` uses the [`AccessibleRole.combo_box`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:combo_box) role.

get_expression.brief: Gets the expression set that is used to obtain strings from items.
get_expression.md:
Gets the expression set that is used to obtain strings from items.

See [`DropDown.set_expression()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#method:set_expression).

get_factory.brief: Gets the factory that's currently used to populate list items.
get_factory.md:
Gets the factory that's currently used to populate list items.

The factory returned by this function is always used for the
item in the button. It is also used for items in the popup
if [`DropDown:list-factory`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#property:list-factory) is not set.

get_header_factory.brief: Gets the factory that's currently used to create header widgets for the popup.
get_header_factory.md: Gets the factory that's currently used to create header widgets for the popup.

get_list_factory.brief: Gets the factory that's currently used to populate list items in the popup.
get_list_factory.md: Gets the factory that's currently used to populate list items in the popup.

get_model.brief: Gets the model that provides the displayed items.
get_model.md: Gets the model that provides the displayed items.

get_search_match_mode.brief: Returns the match mode that the search filter is using.
get_search_match_mode.md: Returns the match mode that the search filter is using.

get_selected.brief: Gets the position of the selected item.
get_selected.md: Gets the position of the selected item.

get_selected_item.md: Gets the selected item. If no item is selected, `NULL` is returned.

get_show_arrow.brief: Returns whether to show an arrow within the widget.
get_show_arrow.md: Returns whether to show an arrow within the widget.

set_enable_search.brief: Sets whether a search entry will be shown in the popup that allows to search for items in the list.
set_enable_search.md:
Sets whether a search entry will be shown in the popup that
allows to search for items in the list.

Note that [`DropDown:expression`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#property:expression) must be set for
search to work.

set_expression.brief: Sets the expression that gets evaluated to obtain strings from items.
set_expression.md:
Sets the expression that gets evaluated to obtain strings from items.

This is used for search in the popup. The expression must have
a value type of %G_TYPE_STRING.

set_factory.brief: Sets the `GtkListItemFactory` to use for populating list items.
set_factory.md: Sets the `GtkListItemFactory` to use for populating list items.

set_header_factory.brief: Sets the `GtkListItemFactory` to use for creating header widgets for the popup.
set_header_factory.md: Sets the `GtkListItemFactory` to use for creating header widgets for the popup.

set_list_factory.brief: Sets the `GtkListItemFactory` to use for populating list items in the popup.
set_list_factory.md: Sets the `GtkListItemFactory` to use for populating list items in the popup.

set_search_match_mode.brief: Sets the match mode for the search filter.
set_search_match_mode.md: Sets the match mode for the search filter.

set_selected.brief: Selects the item at the given position.
set_selected.md: Selects the item at the given position.

set_show_arrow.brief: Sets whether an arrow will be displayed within the widget.
set_show_arrow.md: Sets whether an arrow will be displayed within the widget.

enable-search.brief: Whether to show a search entry in the popup.
enable-search.md:
Whether to show a search entry in the popup.

Note that search requires [`DropDown:expression`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#property:expression)
to be set.

expression.brief: An expression to evaluate to obtain strings to match against the search term.
expression.md:
An expression to evaluate to obtain strings to match against the search
term.

See [`DropDown:enable-search`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#property:enable-search) for how to enable search.
If [`DropDown:factory`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#property:factory) is not set, the expression is also
used to bind strings to labels produced by a default factory.

header-factory.brief: The factory for creating header widgets for the popup.
header-factory.md: The factory for creating header widgets for the popup.

list-factory.brief: The factory for populating list items in the popup.
list-factory.md:
The factory for populating list items in the popup.

If this is not set, [`DropDown:factory`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropDown#property:factory) is used.

search-match-mode.brief: The match mode for the search filter.
search-match-mode.md: The match mode for the search filter.

selected.brief: The position of the selected item.
selected.md:
The position of the selected item.

If no item is selected, the property has the value
%GTK_INVALID_LIST_POSITION.

show-arrow.brief: Whether to show an arrow within the GtkDropDown widget.
show-arrow.md: Whether to show an arrow within the GtkDropDown widget.

activate.brief: Emitted to when the drop down is activated.
activate.md:
Emitted to when the drop down is activated.

The `::activate` signal on `GtkDropDown` is an action signal and
emitting it causes the drop down to pop up its dropdown.
